servicesSummary: The Province of New Brunswick The registrant engaged a subcontractor, the Ingram Group, to provide U.S. government outreach and U.S. communications support with respect to trade policy and did not itself engage in any outreach.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $141,782.50 in total receipts and $76,032.62 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total. Itemized financial rows require an exact known principal, real date, counterparty, purpose and amount. U.S. political contacts require an itemized principal/date/contact/method/purpose row. No payment to a politician or principal-specific share is inferred.
